title_zh: 核对产地标签后选购胡萝卜

scenario.label_zh: 核对市集蔬菜的产地与有机标识
scenario.goal_zh: 区分产地信息与种植方式，查看包装标识后选定胡萝卜

context_zh: 顾客在市集询问两个摊箱里的胡萝卜。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Are these organic carrots, or does the sign only mean they're grown nearby?

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: The sign gives their origin. It doesn't describe the farming method.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: I see. Do you have any with an organic label?

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: These sealed bags do. The producer's details and certification mark are on the back.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Let me check that. Yes, these are the ones I want. I'll take one bag.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Certainly. I'll leave the label on so you have the details.
